supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-billing authentication failures occurred on FILE-PIN-01 from 13:36 through 13:51 UTC. The events show the same process name and PID, source address 10.51.20.20, and bad-password status 0xc000006a.

Domain-controller records corroborate bad-password or Kerberos pre-authentication failures for svc-billing from FILE-PIN-01's source address; the provided records do not show a successful authentication.

The repeated failures are consistent with the scheduled svc-billing password rotation and the inventory's every-minute BillingSync re-authentication on FILE-PIN-01, but the logs do not establish that the rotation occurred or that a stale job password caused the failures.

At 13:20 UTC, WS-ESTONE-01 recorded a SYSTEM process (taskhostw.exe) using explicit credentials for svc-billing while targeting PROXY-PIN-01. This is outside the inventory-described BillingSync use on FILE-PIN-01; the record establishes credential use was attempted, not that proxy authentication succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include proxy authentication results or corresponding successful logon events.
The 4648 event does not provide a command line, process ancestry, or enough context to determine why taskhostw.exe on WS-ESTONE-01 used svc-billing credentials.
The source address 10.51.20.20 is present in the authentication records, but no address-to-host mapping is provided.
The scheduled rotation is described in the environment context, but the supplied logs do not confirm when or whether the password change was completed.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-billing credential use from WS-ESTONE-01 was authorized or malicious.
Whether the 13:20 credential attempt against PROXY-PIN-01 succeeded.
Whether the later failures were caused by BillingSync continuing to use a pre-rotation password.
Whether any successful svc-billing authentication or other activity occurred outside the supplied records.
additional_evidence_needed: Review WS-ESTONE-01 endpoint telemetry for taskhostw.exe process ancestry, command line, user/session context, and related activity around 13:20 UTC.
Obtain PROXY-PIN-01 authentication and access logs for the svc-billing attempt at 13:20 UTC.
Verify the actual password-rotation time and BillingSync credential update and execution history on FILE-PIN-01.
Correlate the source address 10.51.20.20 with asset/network records and review relevant successful and failed authentication events for svc-billing.
